Once upon a time there were four little rabbits. <break time="0.8s" /> Their names were Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton tail, and Peter. <break time="0.8s" /> They lived with their mother under a big fir tree. <break time="0.8s" /> You may play in the fields, said Mother Rabbit. <break time="0.8s" /> But do not go into Mister McGregors garden. <break time="0.8s" /> Your father had an accident there. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she went to the bakers with her basket. <break time="0.8s" /> The three good bunnies went to pick blackberries.

옛날 옛적에. <break time="0.8s" /> 아기 토끼 네 마리가 있었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 아기 토끼들의 이름은 플롭시, 몹시, 코튼테일, 그리고 피터였어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 토끼들은 살았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마와 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 커다란 전나무 아래에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 놀아도 된단다. <break time="0.8s" /> 들판에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마 토끼가 말했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 들어가지 마라. <break time="0.8s" /> 맥그리거 씨네 밭 안으로는. <break time="0.8s" /> 너희 아빠가 사고를 당했단다 거기서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 엄마는 갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 빵집에 바구니를 들고. <break time="0.8s" /> 착한 세 아기 토끼는. <break time="0.8s" /> 블랙베리를 따러 갔어요.

But Peter was very naughty. <break time="0.8s" /> He ran to the garden. <break time="0.8s" /> And squeezed under the gate. <break time="0.8s" /> He ate. <break time="0.8s" /> Lettuces, beans, and radishes. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he felt sick. <break time="0.8s" /> And looked for some parsley. <break time="0.8s" /> But there was Mister McGregor. <break time="0.8s" /> Stop, thief. <break time="0.8s" /> He shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> And ran after Peter. <break time="0.8s" /> Peter lost his shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> Among the cabbages and potatoes. <break time="0.8s" /> Then his jacket. <break time="0.8s" /> Got caught in a net.

하지만 피터는 아주 말썽꾸러기였어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 밭으로 달려갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 문 밑으로 비집고 들어갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 먹었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 상추와 콩과 무를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러다 피터는 속이 안 좋았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 파슬리를 찾았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 거기에 맥그리거 씨가 있었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 멈춰라, 도둑아. <break time="0.8s" /> 맥그리거 씨가 소리쳤어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 피터를 쫓아갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 신발을 잃어버렸어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 양배추와 감자 사이에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그때 피터의 웃옷이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그물에 걸렸어요.

Peter cried. <break time="0.8s" /> But friendly sparrows. <break time="0.8s" /> Begged him to try hard. <break time="0.8s" /> Mister McGregor came with a sieve. <break time="0.8s" /> But Peter wriggled out. <break time="0.8s" /> He left. <break time="0.8s" /> His new blue jacket behind. <break time="0.8s" /> He jumped. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a watering can in the tool shed. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a lot of water. <break time="0.8s" /> In it. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Peter sneezed Kertyschoo. <break time="0.8s" /> He jumped out of the window. <break time="0.8s" /> And got away. <break time="0.8s" /> Peter was wet. <break time="0.8s" /> Tired and lost.

피터는 울었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 친절한 참새들이. <break time="0.8s" /> 힘을 내라고 간절히 말했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 맥그리거 씨가 체를 들고 왔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 피터는 꿈틀꿈틀 빠져나왔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 두고 갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 자기의 새 파란 웃옷을. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 뛰어들었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 물뿌리개 속으로 연장 헛간에 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 물이 아주 많았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 안에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그때 피터가 재채기를 했어요 에취. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 창문 밖으로 뛰어내렸어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 도망쳤어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 몸이 젖었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 지쳤어요 그리고 길을 잃었어요.

He asked an old mouse. <break time="0.8s" /> The way to the gate. <break time="0.8s" /> But she had a big pea. <break time="0.8s" /> In her mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> He climbed on a wheelbarrow. <break time="0.8s" /> And saw the gate. <break time="0.8s" /> He ran fast. <break time="0.8s" /> And slipped under the gate. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he ran home. <break time="0.8s" /> To the big fir tree. <break time="0.8s" /> That evening. <break time="0.8s" /> Peter was not very well. <break time="0.8s" /> Mother gave him. <break time="0.8s" /> Some camomile tea. <break time="0.8s" /> In bed. <break time="0.8s" /> But his sisters had bread, milk, and blackberries. <break time="0.8s" /> For supper.

피터는 늙은 생쥐에게 물었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 문으로 가는 길을. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 생쥐는 물고 있었어요 커다란 완두콩을. <break time="0.8s" /> 입에. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 손수레 위에 올라갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 문을 보았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 빨리 달렸어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 문 밑으로 쏙 빠져나갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 피터는 집으로 달려갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 커다란 전나무까지. <break time="0.8s" /> 그날 저녁. <break time="0.8s" /> 피터는 몸이 별로 좋지 않았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마는 피터에게 주었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 캐모마일 차를. <break time="0.8s" /> 침대에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 세 자매는 먹었어요 빵과 우유와 블랙베리를. <break time="0.8s" /> 저녁으로.
